title: Soccer on Mars
body: An astronaut on Mars kicks a soccer ball at an angle of $$45**\circ$$ with an initial velocity of $$15\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$. $$The$$ $$acceleration$$ $$of$$ $$gravity$$ $$on$$ $$Mars$$ $$is$$ $$3.7\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$.
lesson: 4. Motion in Two and Three Dimensions
